text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober trembles with joy after<n>she
manages to display her full<n>power in the race. She
also thanks<n>everyone in the waiting room for their
support.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following her debut, public opinion on<n>Mejiro
Dober rises rapidly and all<n>eyes turn to her as the
new hope for<n>the Mejiro family!
